field_representation: N48 reconstruction from published P4 h35 FEM; standing wave uses existing sine RF quadrature; no FEM solve
normalization_scope: All new v2 comparisons use equal peak voltage only. Matched pseudopotential pilot remains a separate 16-start result in v1.

radial_launch_ensemble.locally_enriched_boundary_grid: azimuths [0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2, pi/4, 3pi/4] crossed with phases [0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2] at selected mixed radii; n=24
radial_launch_ensemble.adaptive_refinement_note: Additional measured points at 0.0625-mm spacing in observed transition neighborhoods; 336 new trajectories in the final refinement stage. Mixed selected nodes use n=24; midpoint screening nodes use n=4.
radial_launch_ensemble.outer_extension_note: Additional 96 baseline launches (n=4 per model/mass/radius) evaluated toward the 8-mm aperture.
radial_launch_ensemble.outer_enriched_note: All previously screened baseline launch states are reused by job_id; only missing phases/azimuths were integrated.

seed: regular deterministic quadrature grid; no random sampling
note: Retention means survival for 300 RF periods in 2D transverse N48 dynamics; it is not infinite-time stability or 3D transmission.
audit_note_unit_error: Two superseded auxiliary outputs used q_macro/m_physical and are preserved with unit_error labels; excluded from every scientific analysis and figure.
